name: s81sl_cap_rt_rf1
structural_change: S81-RF1 RE-FORM (DIE-S81-51/RF-B 11-03, OWNER TWO-STRIKES): (1) SRAM on the S edge (die x 34.56, y 4.368; was the block centre 43.2/43.2 splitting the std-cell area into two bands), S-face outputs moved into the W (x 5-29) and E (x 214-254.5) channels beside it; (2) three clock entries of the one ck_rt root: clk (n6/FIN/DEC/adder/faces ~4.5k sinks), clk_g0 (slot groups 0-3, ~3.3k), clk_g1 (groups 4-7, ~3.3k), was 10,723 sinks on one entry (TT insertion 290-444, related-pair skew 152 > 80); (3) group-local key compare (1-bit hit per group; was the 24-bit 8:1 across groups + compare, TT -108.98/-158 placed la_gs/lb_sl -> fa_kh/fb_kh), 0 edges moved, lockstep bench RF1 0 vs 1 PASS; (4) negative-level lockup latch on every output face bit, 0 cycles.

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (S81-SLICE): every data input lands in a flop at the pin (the *_c capture flops) and every output is a flop; recipe-3 pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage on every slice seam.

why_floorplan: 259.2 x 108 (S81U-CAP3): SRAM at (43.2, 43.2) on the 43.2 lattice (CAP2 had it off-lattice at 23.04 / 23.76); its rd_out pins sit on its W edge and wd_in on its E edge, so the outline is 6 lattice steps wide to leave a ~42-um std-cell column on each side; one contiguous ring band (S 41 um: DEC + cw outputs to the S face; N 33 um: n6 / FIN under the N pins; W/E 41-42 um: pairing store, beside the macro's ports). clk/rst_n mid N face between the trees (cluster spine channel); N face = W-tree word (under u_tw), cfg + cw_n (middle), E-tree word (under u_te MY); S face cw_s + fault; ~10k flops, one root. S81U-CAP5: clk moved to the N-face centre 128-131 um (was 106-110), rst_n / cw_n_v / cw_n_a shifted W of it. S81U-CAP5 gate 2 (a83851436): TT 326.9 / spread 104.3 with the latest sinks = u_n6 adder / port flops in the top-right density hotspot of the 27.5-um N band (78.3..105.8 above the macro): outline 108 -> 116.64 so the N band is ~36 um like the S band (macro stays at (43.2, 43.2) on the lattice; util ~46%).
